## What this workflow does

Every day at 7:00 AM it collects what the day has in store
and emails a single text summary:
- Today's Google Calendar events
- Current weather in San Salvador (Open-Meteo, no API key)
- Pending Google Tasks (due today or overdue)

Build Summary merges the three sources into one email that
Gmail SMTP delivers to your inbox.

It runs in the workflow timezone (America/El_Salvador):
settings.timezone drives both the schedule trigger and the
$now day bounds computed by the Code nodes.

### Setup (one time, ~10 minutes)

Three n8n credentials are needed:
1. Google Calendar OAuth2 -> Fetch Calendar
2. Google Tasks OAuth2     -> Fetch Tasks
3. SMTP (Gmail app password) -> Send Email

Replace the REPLACE_WITH_* placeholders:
- REPLACE_WITH_SENDER_EMAIL / REPLACE_WITH_RECIPIENT_EMAIL
  in Send Email
- the credential IDs on Fetch Tasks, Fetch Calendar and
  Send Email

> No secrets live in this file. Credentials go into n8n's
> encrypted credential store, never in workflow.json.
